provider.name: Hetzner
provider.summary: A dedicated server you rent whole, billed by the hour, in Hetzner's own data centres in Germany and Finland. The figure is the one the GPU matrix prints under the server - the server with the IPv4 address it is sold with - read from the price endpoint the page itself asks, in the dollars Hetzner publishes beside its euro price. It says "starting from" because the server comes in three types. A one-off setup fee of $699 is charged on top and is not part of this rate.
provider.notes: GPU matrix read for the products and their keys, Hetzner's own keyless price endpoint for the hourly figure under each; the composite product key is read from the page, never assembled, and the endpoint answers it as one product; all three datacenters (FSN1, NBG1, HEL1) carry the same figure, so one quote with no region; the one-off setup fee and the monthly price are not read; GEX45's RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell SFF Edition has no id on this site and stays unmapped
